BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Goudvis!!
Phew, we finally made it out~!
What about Unda?
I'm okay.\nTch, stop being so considerate.\nIt just reminds me how pathetic I am.
Well, it's good that we made it out in one piece.\nBut what do we do now?
I've been thinking about it for a long time too...\nI'm thinking of going back to my homeland, Raela,\nonce more.
What? Are you sure it's okay?\nWhat if they catch you and take you to the\nexecution grounds again?
This time, I'll be going in quietly...
What's your plan?
Honestly, I never wanted the throne.\nBut after seeing how the people of Raela suffer,\nI can't just turn my back.
Hmph, turns out the royals are nastier than\nI thought. I'll save my homeland from this crisis\nmy way this time...
That would put us in quite a bind, Sir Unda...
The Supersteel Shell Knights of Raela!\nSo you knew about this secret passage!
Huh? Supersteel what? Who are they...?
They're the elite army of Raela. Clad in heavy\narmor made from steel shells found in the deep\nsea, they have an indomitable fighting spirit!
My name is Goudvis, and I currently serve as the\nleader. Our time may be brief, but I hope you'll\nremember me.
Allow me to add something to what was just said.\nWe are a unit directly under the king...Even if\nyou're a royal, we cannot obey your orders.
But as far as I know, my brother hasn't become\nking yet!
Still, for the sake of the nation's safety,\nwe shall follow His Majesty's command.
We were ordered to check if you're still alive.\nIf you've fled the country, then it's fine.\nIf not...
Then we must take your life...
My gosh! It feels like there's no room for\ndiscussion.
You're right. He doesn't seem like someone we can\njoke with.
Yeah! We've got to go all out against this guy!
I'm not just gonna stand by and let you protect\nme! I'm joining the fight too! Let's do this!
Heh heh heh, never thought a royal could do\nthis...\nYou're pretty good, Sir Unda...
Hmph! Don't you dare compare me to my brother and\nhis flimsy fighting skills!
Your attacks are remarkable. I can feel your\nstrong determination. However, our reinforcements\nare on their way. You should just give up now...
Nope, they're not coming!
Huh?!
You guys!
Sorry, sir, we're late!
Don't worry, sir! The other comrades we rescued\nare keeping their reinforcements occupied!
Good job! Alright, it's time to strike back!
Yes, sir!!
Sir, looks like our allies are pulling back!\nWe won't hold out if this keeps up!
Ugh...
Strong fighting spirit, excellent leadership and\nsolidarity...If he were king, maybe our\nhomeland would be...Oh, I'd better not say that...
Command every unit to withdraw now!
Yes, sir!
I hope we shall meet again, Sir Unda...\nUnder different circumstances, I hope...
Sir! We did it!
Yeah! Thanks to you guys!
Nah, it's thanks to the adventurer for\nsaving us...Otherwise, we'd have ended up on the\nrocks like dried fish by now!
Hahaha, don't get me started! I owe the adventurer\nso much, I don't think I could ever pay it back,\neven if I spent my entire life...
Whoa, what the...?!
Oh, sorry for startling you!\nWe stripped this armor off the enemies we beat.\nIt's sturdy and useful...
Hm, I see.
Would you like to try one on too, sir?\nWe've taken a ton of armor from the enemies.
A ton, you say? Hmm...this looks useful.
Sir?
If we wear this, we'll be able to sneak into\nRaela's palace without anyone noticing.
I knew you hadn't given up after all~.
I told ya I'm gonna do things my way this time!
Alright! Go tell everyone here to put on this\narmor!
Got it!
Well, thanks for all your help, but this is where\nwe part ways. I can't get you involved in Raela's\nfamily feud.
Don't get ahead of yourself!\nWe never planned to help you that far in the first\nplace!
Well, it's the path you've chosen. Do as you like.
Aye! I'll support you too!
Oh, thanks!
Oh, just one more thing.\nIt's been bothering me since we met again.\nWhere is she? I mean Mare.
Oh, Mare? She headed back home.\nShe's got a busy schedule, you know?
Ahh, I see...I bet she does.
Well, the reason we came to save you was because\nof Mare, though. She was worried about you and\ntold us to~.
What?! Really?!
Mwahaha!\nShe looked like she was about to explode from all\nthat worrying!
Ugh, I told ya to stop laughing like that, it's\ncreepy!
I see...so she was worried about me...
What's that? Trash? Please throw it away yourself!
Hahaha, that's so mean!\nI might not make it back this time,\nso please give this to her as a keepsake.
Alright, I'm counting on you!\nI wish you all the best on your adventure too!
A keepsake? This little piece of cloth?
Even though he's a royal, he's got no taste at\nall...
Oh yeah! I forgot one thing!
My gosh! You scared me!
Hey, Lixi, yes, you!
Aye?
Remember I said the Gourmet loves Lixis?
Apparently, before joining forces with Raela, that\ncreature was on an "expedition" to the village of\nLixis. You'll find it if you keep going straight!
If I'm not mistaken, Fango is the name of the\nvillage. You might be able to find your kind there\nif they're still alive.
The journey to get there might be a bit\nchallenging, but I'm sure you can make it easily!\nBye then!
The village of Lixis?
If that's true, Anono will finally be able to\nreunite with his friends!
Aye! My friends!
Alright! Let's hurry then!
